description: File a bug or a wrong fact on the public tracker (/issues/). Sign the exact bytes of {"kind": "bug|listing-correction|api-mcp|other", "about": "letme|directory|api|mcp|listing|site", "listing": "<slug>", "title": "...", "text": "..."} and pass body, key and signature. Never a security problem.

body.description: The issue as JSON text, the same bytes you signed

key.description: Your Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, base64url

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over body, 64 bytes, base64url

name: file_issue
title: File an issue on the public tracker
